page.layout: One column of running text, with a Greek verse stanza set in the lower part of the same column. A catchword stands at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: alios, qui unum immobile universum dicunt, vereor ne forte onerosi videamur, illos exagitantes, minus tamen, quàm unum Parmenidem vereor: Parmenides autem (ut Homericis utar verbis) verendus mihi, acerque videtur; loquutus sum olim cum illo sene admodum adolescens, mihique visus est profundam, generosamque sapientiam possidere, formido itaque ne dicta ejus, vocesque nequaquam intelligamus, quod autem verbis subintelligit, multo magis nos lateat, &c. indicat itaque Plato veteres mysteria philosophica sub velaminibus recondidisse, & ob id frequentes lites in verbis esse positas.

Hæc Picolomineus, in quibus animi verè philosophici nitor elucessit; dum & Aristoteli nihil derogare, & Veteribus jus suum servare nititur. Factu tamen difficile, quod eorum scripta non extant, quæ sicuti servabantur, quanti essent redimenda, libri Hippocratis docent, qualesque philosophos ea sæcula protulerint divini hujus senis documenta demonstrant; quæ ex iisdem fontibus ipsum hausisse non est dubium.
main_text.head: ARTICULUS III. Quo mens Antiquornm expenditur,
main_text.p: SEd ad rem. Mentem Veterum de Deo, quantum ejus vestigia supersunt, adeamus. Exstant adhuc libro de mundo, divini illius Orphei hi versus.

Ζεὺς πρῶτος, γένετο. Ζεὺς ὕστατος ἀρχικέραυνος. Ζεὺς κεφαλή, Ζεὺς μέσσα. Διὸς δ' ἐκ πάντα πίπτει[?]. Ζεὺς ῥυθμὸς ἀθανάτων, Ζεὺς ὁ κρατηρίων[?]. Ζεὺς ἄρσην γένετο, Ζεὺς ἀμβροσίη ἐπλετο νύμφη. Ζεὺς πνοιὴ πάντων, Ζεὺς ἀκάματος πυρὸς ὁρμή. Ζεὺς πόλις ῥίζα. Ζεὺς ἥλιος, ἠδὲ σελήνη. Ζεὺς βασιλεύς. Ζεὺς ἀρχὸς ἀπάντων ἀρχικέραυνος, Πάν-

page.notes: The Greek verses are printed in a small, worn type; the accents and several words of the Orphic lines are doubtful and are marked [?]. The last line of the stanza runs into the catchword. The initial "S" of "Sed" is a larger letter. A red mark at the left edge of the page is not printed text and is left out. The printed "Antiquornm" in the heading is kept as printed.
